sentences.en: It is sweet and right to die for your homeland.
sentences.zh: 为国捐躯是光荣而正确的。

sentences.en: Palestinian refugees should be allowed to return to their homeland.
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦难民应该被允许返回他们的祖国。

sentences.en: Mr. and Mrs. Yamada will return to their homeland next month.
sentences.zh: 山田夫妇下个月将回到他们的家乡。

senses.zh: 祖国，家乡,（南非种族隔离制度下的）黑人住宅区
